statement.excerpt: This is why every AI startup is inherently unprofitable — they’re literally sending every penny of their venture capital money directly to Anthropic and OpenAI to power their unprofitable services.

from_speaker: literally sending every penny of their venture capital money
our_interpretation: The plain reading asserts universal company losses and universal allocation of venture funding to the two named vendors, with token purchases causing those losses.
Every penny is read literally because the speaker explicitly emphasizes it; a looser rhetorical reading remains possible.
AI startup is not restricted to companies reselling those two vendors' models.
No accounting basis is stated. Profitability reports with unspecified definitions cannot be silently converted into net-income evidence.
The listed conditions describe the claimed population and spending share, not antecedents of a conditional forecast.
criteria.support_condition: Comprehensive comparable financial and expenditure records establish losses across AI startups, show all venture funds going to the two named vendors, and establish the proposed causal connection.
criteria.contradiction_condition: A qualifying startup demonstrates profitability on a matching basis, or traced venture-funded expenditure goes elsewhere. A demonstrated alternative operating model can also undermine the claimed universal causal mechanism.
